from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u080/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4ad498ca.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    anchors = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if len(anchors) != 2:
        return out
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The anchor with nearby colored cells is the source; the isolated 5 is the target.
    counts = []
    for ar, ac in anchors:
        counts.append(sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                          if grid[r][c] and (r, c) != (ar, ac)))
    src = anchors[counts.index(max(counts))]
    dst = anchors[1 - counts.index(max(counts))]
    sr, sc = src
    dr, dc = dst
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r, c) != src:
                nr, nc = dr + r - sr, dc + c - sc
                if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w:
                    out[nr][nc] = grid[r][c]
    out[dr][dc] = 0
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)
